verdict.rationale: cubic documents its own Analytics API, which exposes PR-level data on flagged issues, fixes and AI-authored code. That is a real public API, but it is scoped to reading analytics rather than driving the product's core actions, such as triggering reviews, applying fixes or changing configuration. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for triggering reviews, fixes and configuration; API reference or OpenAPI spec; auth/rate-limit docs; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed, how much AI code was authored, etc.
